=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1244 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The PR-named run lookup accepts runs without verifying default-branch provenance or pairing each workflow path with its specific title, allowing a forged run to affect retry dispatch and budget decisions.
  WHY: A branch writer can dispatch a run with a matching PR title, causing the retrigger peer check to skip a dispatch or the changes-lost budget to miscount a retry; severity differed between the security finding and the secondary path-regex finding, so the higher severity is used.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:316 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_active_run_count` counts PR-named runs without verifying that `head_branch` equals the default branch.
  WHY: A spoofed run from a non-default branch can be counted as an active review for the PR, holding back the §26 checker hand-off while the forged run is active.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Every PR-named match in the poller should check `head_branch == default_branch` (provenance) and the wrapper path that sets the run name (identity); the same fix is deferred for `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` and `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`'s `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs`.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` (`_active_run_count`); `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` (`_autofix_pr_named_review_runs`)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `_active_run_count` (line 313-317) selects with `_is_pr_named_review_pair(run, pr_number)` only; the jq filter inside `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` (line 1239-1248) selects on `event`, `path`, and `display_title` but not on `head_branch`; no test in this PR covers a forged PR-named run from a non-default branch being filtered out of either helper; the issue #5094 plan's "Residual same-pattern matchers" section names both files by line number as out of scope.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1244 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function does not verify that head_branch equals the default branch (provenance) and does not pair the workflow path with its specific title (identity). A run dispatched on any branch with a workflow file named internal-review.yml or ai-review.yml that sets either PR-named title is accepted.
  WHY: A writer who pushes a branch can dispatch a workflow_dispatch run at that branch whose copy sets run-name to another PR's title. The retrigger peer check (autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer) and the changes-lost budget (autofix_changes_lost_head_retry_consumed) then skip the dispatch or miscount the retry.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1244 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The path regex accepts any parent directory rather than requiring .github/workflows/ specifically.
  WHY: This is a secondary detail that does not independently enable exploitation; the absence of head_branch and path/title pairing is the root cause covered by the SECURITY finding above.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:316 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function reads PR_NAMED_REVIEW_RUNS_PATH (a repo-wide actions/runs listing) and matches runs by (path, display_title) pair only. It does not check that the run's head_branch is the default branch.
  WHY: A spoofed dispatch run on a non-default branch that sets the PR-named title is counted as an active review run for that PR. The §26 checker then holds a hand-off back while the forged run is active, preventing the real fixer from being woken.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

The "Residual same-pattern matchers outside this scope" section of that plan explicitly defers the same fix in `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` and `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`'s `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` to a follow-up.
  Expected change site: `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:294` (`_active_run_count`); the sibling helper `_is_pr_dispatched_review_run` at line 338 already does this; `scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1208` (`_autofix_pr_named_review_runs`) has the same gap.
  Evidence of absence: `_active_run_count` (line 313-317) selects with `_is_pr_named_review_pair(run, pr_number)` only. The jq filter inside `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` (line 1239-1248) selects on `event`, `path`, and `display_title` but not on `head_branch`. No test in this PR covers a forged PR-named run from a non-default branch being filtered out of either helper. The issue #5094 plan's "Residual same-pattern matchers" section names both files by line number as out of scope.
